sample_unit: patients (EMRs); 366 cases in the validation sample

links.outcome: LLM extraction agreement with oncologist annotations on local EMRs
links.effect: High agreement for Ki-67 (ICC 0.882), grade (κ 0.887), ER (κ 0.997), PR (κ 0.975), HER2 (κ 0.935). Date extraction had a high degree of missing data.
links.quote: LLM-human agreement was high (Ki-67 ICC = 0.882; grade κ = 0.887; ER κ = 0.997; PR κ = 0.975; HER2 κ = 0.935).

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs with domain-engineered prompts to structure non-English unstructured EMRs into research datasets

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates an LLM's accuracy for information extraction from non-English electronic medical records compared to oncologist annotations and uses the extracted data for clinical survival analysis, without testing an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
